title: Processing Types
description: Shared types for the dataQuality, processing and signalJourney extensions and the view declaration. A library of $defs; the root constrains nothing.

recipeId.description: Identifier of a NEMAR processing recipe (for example nemar-floor), lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

version.description: A version label (recipe, dataset or plugin version) of letters, digits and . _ + -.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of a file's bytes.

checkpointName.description: Name of a processing checkpoint: a coarse stage a recipe declares. Open vocabulary; the writer checks it against the checkpoints the recipe version declares.

stepId.description: Identifier of a recipe step (the step names of a recipe's step order).

failureCode.description: Machine-readable failure or skip code, lowercase snake case.

metricName.description: Name of a quality metric, safe as a document key (no . or $): a recipe's metric by a bare name, or a plugin's by <plugin>:<name>, one colon and a name after it that starts with a letter. In a recording's dataQuality metrics each name is paired with its producer (dataQuality.schema.json, recordRecipeResults.metrics: a bare name requires recipe, a prefixed one plugin); that the prefix is the producing plugin's name is the writer's rule.

relativeLocation.description: Relative POSIX path inside a run's product: no leading slash, no .. segment, no URI scheme, no backslash, no control characters.

inputKind.description: What a run read: a BIDS dataset directory or NEMAR's Zarr serving copy.

profile.description: Which copy of the data a run's results describe: the archived recordings or the serving copy.

inputProfilePairing.description: A zarr input always describes the serving copy and a bids input the archive.

range.description: A closed numeric range; either end may be null when unbounded or unknown.

plugin.description: The quality plugin, by name and version, that produced a value or view.

name.description: Plugin name as declared in its manifest.

version.description: Plugin version as declared in its manifest.

recipe.description: The NEMAR processing recipe, by id and version, that produced a value or view.

viewKey.description: Key of a view declaration, unique within its recipe entry: lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

kindName.description: Namespaced name of a view kind (for example nemar.table): a lowercase namespace, then one or more dot-separated segments of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Open vocabulary; views/registry.json lists the kinds neuroschema defines.

transformName.description: Namespaced, versioned name of a view transform (for example nemar.ic-activity.v1): a name shaped like a kind name, then .v and the version number (1 to 999).

roleName.description: Name of a data role or input role in a view (for example values, layout): lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

dimName.description: Name of a dimension of a view's data (for example sensor, freq). Open vocabulary; views/registry.json lists the reserved names and their fixed meanings.

formatName.description: Name of a view data format (tsv or json today). Open vocabulary; views/registry.json lists the formats and their grammars.
